answer: You can starve a sybil farm by front-loading its costs. Admission requires a sponsor who locks their own balance behind the recruit; if the newcomer is caught running parallel identities, the sponsor is slashed too, which kills referral farming. In effect the river of free entry disappears, the ember of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the vertex case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
